Bachelor of Science in Data Science - curriculum structure (constructed test document, fictional)
Academic year 2026-27. Students must complete all courses below.

A. Foundation courses and mathematics
1. DASC1001 Introduction to Data Science (6 credits)
   Pre-requisite: nil
   Assessment: 2 assignments, 1 project, 1 final exam
2. DASC1002 Programming for Data Analysis (6 credits)
   Pre-requisite: nil
   Assessment: 4 assignments, 1 midterm
3. MATH1005 Calculus and Linear Algebra (6 credits)
   Pre-requisite: Level 3 in HKDSE Mathematics Extended Module
   Assessment: 3 quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 final exam

B. Core courses and electives
DASC2001 Statistical Learning (6 credits)
Prerequisites: DASC1001 and DASC1002 and
MATH1005
Assessment: 3 assignments, 1 final exam

DASC2002 Databases for Analytics (6 credits)
Prerequisites: DASC1002 or COMP1117
Assessment: 2 assignments, 1 project, 1 final exam

C. Advanced courses
DASC3001 Machine Learning Systems (6 credits)
Prerequisites: DASC2001 and (DASC2002 or
COMP2113)
Assessment: 2 assignments, 1 project, 1 final exam
DASC3002 Data Ethics and Governance (3 credits)
Prerequisite: Completion of 48 credits
Assessment: 2 essays, 1 presentation

Capstone
DASC4001 Capstone Project (12 credits)
Prerequisite: DASC3001
Assessment: 1 proposal, 1 report, 1 demonstration
